title: Employment status activation omits its EMPLOYEE_DOCUMENT_REQUIRED refusal
actual: On this reinstalled DEV server, POST /hr/employees/36/status as demo.hr with status Active and a synthetic reason returns 409 EMPLOYEE_DOCUMENT_REQUIRED. get_endpoint lists only VALIDATION_ERROR; no activation occurs. The fixture is our new synthetic Nursing employee36, still Draft, without CNIC document.
expected: Preserve the document requirement and name EMPLOYEE_DOCUMENT_REQUIRED (and other reachable activation refusals) in this status route's error contract. The #48 fix and connecting workflow require clients to handle every actual refusal by code.
steps: Create an own synthetic Nursing profile via POST /hr/employees (201), without any document; POST its /status {status:'Active',reason:'synthetic test'} as demo.hr. Compare the returned refusal with get_endpoint errors. No employee/user belonging to another developer was changed.
